notes.title: Major Update - AI Bots
notes.notes:
Configurable AI bots are now available to play with and against!
A bot options menu has been added to match configuration where you can select their difficulty and whether you want them to fill up the match to the selected maximum players (default) or just keep the teams even.
Bots will automatically be added and removed as players join according to the selected setting.

notes.title: Single Player Entertainment Update 16/12/2017
notes.notes:
We've made waiting more fun!  Choose to host a match and until the next player arrives, you can hone your skills against bots in a pre-game game: fight off increasing hordes of enemies, dodge fireballs, absorb fireballs, cast spells, build forts, towers, or just leisurely explore the island.  Something for everyone!

-The "Pre-Match Entertainment" button is enabled by default in the server options menu in-game.
- After creating a new match there will be Wraiths to fight while you wait for another person to join your game.
- Wraiths are vulnerable to spells
- Wraiths drop blocks, which can be stacked into a protective wall and more.
- Wraith spells can be batted away, dodged, or absorbed.
